ゴミ.definition: n. A word in the Japanese language [which means] "trash", or "garbage". This can be used in 2 different contexts, either referring to an actual trashbin, or to insult someone by calling them "trash". Try not to use this word to refer to others in the latter context, as it is [considered] highly [offensive].
ゴミ.example:
これをゴミ箱に捨ててくれませんか？
"[Do you mind] [throwing] this in the trash for me please?"

おまえわゴミ、黙れ！
"[You're trash], shut up!"
